_comment: The THIRD state this control's docstring exists to separate: `we could not ask` is not `we know it is invalid`. The validator returned an error. Fixed under hold-fix-4277-preflight-fails-closed-and-is-wired-to-the-upgrade (D-CS7, internal/dispatch/reviews/pr-4277.md item 5): this used to emit NO check at all for the bot, which is the exact silent-control defect the D-CS7 programme exists to close — a validator that cannot run must read as WARN 'could not check', never as an absence indistinguishable from a clean pod. Not part of the registry's required pair (tools/control-registry reads known_good.json + known_bad.json); carried here because the distinction is the control's whole point. Replayed by packages/admin/tests/test_oc_runtime_controls.py::test_config_valid_could_not_ask_warns.
